title: Umbris — Mental Breakdown
summary: Exile-theft control steals opposing cards and permanents, then turns everything left in exile into protected commander damage.

tags.name: commander matters
tags.reason: Umbris converts every opponent-owned card in exile into the deck's primary damage engine.

tags.name: exile
tags.reason: Thirty-five cards exile opposing libraries, hands, graveyards, spells, or permanents.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Thirteen explicit theft cards and seventeen play-from-exile cards overlap to make opposing resources the deck's repeatable fuel.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Shared Fate, Knowledge Pool, and Gonti's symmetrical Treasures replace normal draws and hand-casting with communal exile decisions.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Exile removal, graveyard clearing, counters, and library extraction regulate the table while Umbris grows.

tags.name: voltron
tags.reason: Eight delivery effects and six true protection cards support commander-damage kills from an exile-inflated Umbris.

tags.name: clones
tags.reason: Five copy effects create persistent Umbris-sized threats, repeat its entry trigger, or reuse opposing creatures.

tags.name: prison
tags.reason: The namesake enchantment package constrains normal draw and casting without creating a hard lock.

tags.name: mill
tags.reason: Maddening Cacophony is the sole dedicated mill spell and exists only to seed later graveyard exile.
